text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, during training...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Man, I knew something was up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's about my cleats. They felt weird
when I was running earlier.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And look, they're completely worn out. I'll
probably have to buy a
whole new pair.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, reel it in a little, will you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, speaking of! You free on our next day
off? I want your help
picking out a new
pair of cleats for me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like, there's a ton of different types,
right? I always end up buying
the same
ones.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But if you're there with me, we might be
able to find an even better
fit for me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that was easy. Well then, guess we're
hitting the streets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I usually get everything I need from the
school store, so coming to a
pro shop like
this makes me feel like a real athlete.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Though yeesh, there really are all sorts of
cleats out there. Oh man,
how am I
supposed to pick just one?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If only we were looking to buy a
watermelon. Then we could just ask
the
old ladies running the stalls.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whiiich is where you come in, Trainer.
Help me find my perfect pair,
m'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We check out all kinds of different cleats,
and I explain the pros and
cons of each to
Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks for picking them for me.
Can't wait to see how they feel
after I
break 'em in.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But I gotta say, you've really got your eye
on me, don'tcha? You were
talking about
everything, from my best running form to
my habits
while running.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's a pro for you. I guess I was just
surprised, is all. In a good way.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess we should head back to the
academy—ah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having noticed something, Nature walks
up to a store in front of us.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've seen this outfit in a magazine before.
Wow, seeing it in person is
way different.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe a little too girly for me, though.
Hm, but the color is right up
my alley...
Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad! Left you hanging there,
Trainer. Saw an outfit I liked, is
all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm all good now. Wasn't planning on
buying it, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But man, even though it looked real cute
in a magazine, actually
buying it is a whole
different story.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like, the clothes only looked cute because
the model wearing them
was cute, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nice joke. Forget cute, I'd look like
a brute.

text_block_list.name: Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Are you interested in trying on
this outfit?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-nah, it wouldn't look good on me.

text_block_list.name: Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all, miss. For this outfit,
if you tie up your hair a
little higher, it'll
look perfect on you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I see—wait a second! I see what
you're doin', employee of the
month!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're on her side, Trainer?! Like I
said, I'm... um...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! We already bought new
cleats today, so I gotta save
my money!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's how it is, sorry! Trainer, let's go already!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I almost got roped into trying it on.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sure wasn't expecting you to team up the store against me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're still going on about that?!
Flattering me isn't gonna get you

anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You mean during training, right?! Fashion's
a whole different beast!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... Who would've thought shopping
for cleats could be this
tiring?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Nature is open to me picking out
her cleats, it looks like
picking out cute
clothes for her is out of the question.
